description:
A couple photoshoot in Paris should only be about capturing beautiful memories of the two of you while you're having fun!

Not cheesy and unnatural poses, or feeling weird about thinking if you have to smile or look serious.

As a Paris photographer duo we completely get it, all couples we have photographed have been there. And we've been there too actually!

Let's face it... We're not models at all (we love croissants too much for that). But the good thing is we know exactly how to put you at ease to get beautiful and candid images that truly show your personality.

The meeting point will be at Trocadero and we will do a one-hour tour of the neighborhood. You will have a great time having your pictures taken in typical Parisian streets near the Eiffel Tower that are less known by the tourists.
Then we will go walk by the river to take pictures from a unique point of view, and we will finish our tour on a romantic old bridge.

The best is to meet early morning to avoid the crowd and have the best light, but if you can't we're available during the day too!

Whether for a marriage proposal, honeymoon or simply to create memories during your romantic trip, this photoshoot is for you.

If you're looking for a stress-free couple photoshoot in Paris, and pictures with a warm look, feel free to book or send us a message. We would love to help you create beautiful memories!
locationDescription: We will be in the Trocadero neighborhood and we will show you nice places with Eiffel Tower view without much tourists!
